lakeside.notes: Cold exposure unchanged. Water events produce 1.5x more water.

glacier_ridge.notes: Cold-weather events cause an extra 1 HP damage. Water events need stove.

deep_forest.notes: Food/berry events give +100 kcal. Wet-cold and insect events deal extra 1 HP.

valley_floor.notes: All weather HP reduced by 1. Water events x1.2. Navigation events 1 HP worse.

high_plateau.notes: Sun/UV and wind events worse by 1 HP. Navigation events better by 1 HP.

scree_slope.notes: Slip/fall and equipment damage events deal extra 1 HP.

cave_mouth.notes: Cold night events reduced by 1. Food spoilage and night navigation extra 1 HP.

wind_pass.notes: Wind events extra 2 HP. Rain/snow storms extra 1 HP.

boggy_hollow.notes: Water easy but dirty. Insect events extra 1 HP. Without purification water events extra 1 HP.

old_trail.notes: Navigation events reduced by 2 HP. Wildlife (non-attack) become HP 0.
